issues.title: Flat tuple JSON raises uncaught TypeError
issues.explanation: For a flat tuple, serialize() gives '[1, 2, 3]'; json.loads succeeds and tuple(x) is called on each int, raising TypeError, which the except ValueError does not catch. Round-tripping any flat TupleParameter fails, e.g. when a worker reloads a dynamic dependency (issue #2609).

issues.title: Fallback does not guarantee a tuple
issues.explanation: literal_eval returns whatever the literal is, so once the JSON path falls through (e.g. '[1, 2, 3]'), parse returns a list rather than a tuple.
